states.before: ca674e649d^ checker + manifest on current tree: 60 rows, 51 bad = 47 UNLISTED + 4 PATCHED (Silooth 2, Tauntaun 2)
states.after: 0 bad (maker's claim; exclusions now drop exactly the 2 files below)

rule_intent: UNLISTED is a retired-override check: a folded *ArtOverride's packageId must appear in NO list (the mod was deleted). It is not 'must be in the load list'.

reasons: Old checker re-run: exactly 47 ids UNLISTED (27 mandrake.rsw.*, 20 mandrake.rut.*), every one hit in exactly 2 tracked files: infrastructure/state/modlists/world_remake_reinstate.txt and deployed/config/ModsConfig.before-tier-kineticarms.xml. No other tracked file named any of them.
Live ModsConfig.xml (ElementTree, 320 activeMods) and ModsConfig.FULL.LATEST.xml (320): 0 of the 47, 0 ids containing 'artoverride'.

No override folder in src/, in the game Mods folder (instrument probe: 98 mandrake.* packageIds seen, 0 *artoverride), or in workshop 294100: a list naming them would just drop a missing mod, so nothing can load the retired art.

Pre-existing blind spot, unchanged by the commit: 10 untracked game-Config backups (ModsConfig.xml.bak-*, ModsConfig.backup.20260913_mw2cut.xml) name 15-47 of the ids; the checker never read untracked files before or after.
world_remake_reinstate.txt: no .py in the repo reads it; its 61 artoverride rows are all NOT-NEEDED.
before-copies: modset_builder.restore_before copies only the marker-named file (now ModsConfig.before-tier-flowworks.xml); modlist_swap --restore and deploy_custom_mods read FULL.LATEST only.

Caveat: restore_before's no-marker refusal text tells an operator to 'copy a ModsConfig.before-tier-*.xml' by hand, so every before-copy is a documented manual restore source; and the swap marker the new code reads is UNTRACKED live state, contrary to the checker's own tracked-files-only rule, so its input set changes with swap state.

A type-of-record skip (any name in RETIRED_CENSUS, every before-tier-* not named by the marker) silently exempts FUTURE files of that type, including a before-copy taken after a retired id re-enters the live list.

Exact change: replace RETIRED_CENSUS, SWAP_MARKER and _live_before_copy with RECORD_FILES = {'infrastructure/state/modlists/world_remake_reinstate.txt': 'retired-mod census; every artoverride row NOT-NEEDED; no reader', 'deployed/config/ModsConfig.before-tier-kineticarms.xml': '613-mod before-copy predating the fold; marker does not name it; override folders gone so a manual copy-back is moot'}; skip only those relpaths; print each skipped file and reason in main() output so the exemption is visible every run; selftest: a before-tier file NOT in RECORD_FILES naming a retired id stays red.

RSW_Silooth.xml adult lifeStage and RSW_Tauntaun.xml draw the manifest 'new' texPaths directly; textures present in src/RimStarWars/SWBestiary/Textures (3 facings each); larva/dessicated swanimals/* paths also ship there.

Patches deleted on purpose: Silooth_Warbeast.xml in 9767b6a4cd, Tauntaun_CanonArt.xml in 3265277e01 (donor mlie.starwarsanimalcollection retired). Dropping 'patch' and setting donor_literal false is a manifest correction, not a grader edit.
